2. [RARC.5.6.3] Samples both clocks, as the engine does whenever it consumes
   an input ([LTIM.2.8.4]), whatever `clock_ns` the event carries. A pump, at
   its entry and before anything fires, then retracts the expired `ttl` facts,
   a fact being expired when its deadline is at or before the monotonic sample
   ([RARC.5.2.4]). An assert, a retract or a clock move retracts nothing: an
   expired fact stays in working memory until the next pump.

idris.name: rarc_5_2_4__expired_inclusive
idris.note: 'A fact being expired when its deadline is at or before the monotonic sample': the clause's own boundary, which [RARC.5.2.4] states.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__advance
idris.note: THE REFUSED READING: take the event's `clock_ns` if it is newer, else stay -- 'advances the clock if the event carries a newer clock_ns', which the clause does not say. Partial because it models a reading the clause does not admit; kept so that what is ruled out is computed beside what is required.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__event_clock_ignored
idris.note: WHATEVER THE EVENT CARRIES: two events carrying any two `clock_ns` values leave the clock at the sample. A TRANSCRIPTION: the definition reads the sample and not the event, so this is `Refl`; it fails if the definition is changed to read the event and refutes nothing else.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__event_clock_moves_the_refused_only
idris.note: WHERE THE TWO READINGS DIFFER: with the sample's monotonic clock at 5, an event carrying 9 moves the refused clock to 9 and leaves the clause's at 5; one carrying 3 leaves both at 5. Computed. The refused reading lets an event set the clock; the clause lets only a sample.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__sampled
idris.note: THE SAMPLE: the clock after step 2 is the monotonic component of the sample the source gave when the input was consumed, whatever `clock_ns` the event carries. The event's value is an argument the definition does not read.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__clock_after
idris.note: The clock after each tick's sample is taken. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__loaded_is_state
idris.note: A data input prepared on the loaded network, no clock moved. Computed.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__timer_pump
idris.note: The tick's advance, with nothing to sweep, then the re-time; the input pumped.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_4__sweep_net_inv
idris.note: The TTL sweep keeps the invariant.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_4__sweep_net_sub
idris.note: The TTL sweep only removes: the expired ids' retraction and the cascade.

idris.name: iret_19_5__tick_clocked
idris.note: The clock takes the tick's sample (a `Tick` carries the source's monotonic sample, as in Rete/TtlSweep.idr), every fact whose deadline is at or before it is retracted, then the re-time [IRET.19.5] names. Partial for WHERE: this engine does all three as the tick is consumed, where the clause samples at the input and sweeps at the pump's entry, a clock move retracting nothing. The same state once the pump runs after the tick; between the two, an expired fact the clause keeps is gone here.

idris.name: iret_19_5__tick_clocked_view
idris.note: The clause's step, followed by the re-time, keeps the view.

idris.name: ldet_5_8__quiet_tick_clocked
idris.note: When nothing has expired and no verdict moves, the clause's step leaves the deadline table, working memory and the chains as they were and moves the clock.

idris.name: ldet_5_8__quiet_tick_is_retime
idris.note: A tick whose sweep finds nothing expired is, with the clock moved, the re-time alone.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__first_tick_moves_the_clock
idris.note: The clock takes the tick's sample: a tick sampled at 1, with the clock at 0, moves the clock to 1, computed.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__prepare_clocked
idris.note: A tick advances and sweeps and re-times; a data event, carrying no clock in this model, is swept for and applied. Partial for the sweep's placement: the clause sweeps at the pump's entry and an input retracts nothing (RARC.7.15), where this model sweeps as the input is consumed -- one state once the pump runs after a tick, a different order inside the boundary after a data event.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__sweep_net_view
idris.note: The clause's retraction of expired facts keeps the view, retracting in [LDTL.6.1]'s order and cascading.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__one_fact_ready_chain
idris.note: After the clause's prepare of the one input -- sweep, assert, cascade -- A holds its one match, unfired. Computed.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__ticked_chain_ttl
idris.note: After the clause's prepare with a tick that swept, A holds the surviving match alone, unfired. Read off the literal.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__ticked_inputs_ttl
idris.note: The clause's two kinds of input, data events and ticks, interleaved: two asserts and two ticks. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__ticked_is_an_instance_ttl
idris.note: The theorem over the clause's prepare with ticks: a match the sweep ended before the run began is not counted, and A fires once for the one it holds. Executed.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__ticked_ready_ttl
idris.note: The clause's prepare of ticks and data events in order, as a literal: the first tick advances the clock and sweeps nothing, the second advances it and sweeps the expired fact. Computed once.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__two_facts_ready_chain
idris.note: After the clause's prepare of two inputs in order, A holds its two matches, unfired, in assertion order. Read off the literal.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__two_facts_ready_ttl
idris.note: The clause's prepare of two inputs in order -- sweep, assert, cascade, twice -- as a literal: computed once.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__prepare_net_inv
idris.note: The clause's tick, as an advance and a sweep, keeps the invariant; a data event sweeps and applies.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__prepare_net_unfired
idris.note: The clause's tick and a data event, prepared, fire nothing.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__prepared_net
idris.note: The clause's inputs, ticks and data events, prepared in order with no run between them -- each swept for as it is consumed, where the clause sweeps once at the pump's entry. Partial for that placement; the same state once the pump runs when the inputs are ticks.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__prepared_net_inv
idris.note: Prepared inputs keep the invariant.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__prepared_net_unfired
idris.note: Prepared inputs fire nothing.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__sweep_net_inv
idris.note: The clause's sweep keeps the invariant and ends between actions.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__sweep_net_unfired
idris.note: The clause's sweep fires nothing.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__fact_then_tick
idris.note: The clause's two kinds of input: a data event, then a tick. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__fired_then_tick
idris.note: The clause's tick after a run, with a fired activation for the re-time to end. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__gate_open_match
idris.note: After the clause's prepare of the data event alone under the shutting gate, A holds its match. Computed.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__gate_shut_no_match
idris.note: After the clause's prepare of the data event alone, A holds no match: the gate is shut at clock 0. Computed.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__gated_clock
idris.note: The clause's advance executed: the clock at the tick's sample. Computed.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__gated_ready_chain
idris.note: After the clause's prepare of the tick -- advance, sweep, re-time, cascade -- A holds the match the re-time made, unfired. Computed.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__shut_ready_chain
idris.note: After the clause's prepare of the tick under the shutting gate, the re-time has ended A's match. Computed.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__swept_chain
idris.note: After the clause's tick that swept and re-timed, A holds no match. Computed.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__swept_is_an_instance
idris.note: The theorem through the clause's tick that both sweeps and re-times: 0 for 0. Executed.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__swept_ready
idris.note: The clause's tick with a deadline at its sample and a timed chain in one step. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__swept_ready_ttl
idris.note: The clause's order executed: the expired fact retracted at the sample before the re-time; the gate opens on nothing. Computed.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__prepare_clocked_inv
idris.note: The clause's tick, as an advance, a sweep and the re-time with their cascades, keeps the invariant; a data event sweeps and applies.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__prepare_clocked_unfired
idris.note: The clause's tick and a data event, prepared, fire nothing.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__prepared_clocked
idris.note: The clause's inputs, ticks and data events, prepared in order with no run between them, the ticks re-timing -- each swept for as it is consumed, where the clause sweeps once at the pump's entry. Partial for that placement.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__prepared_clocked_append
idris.note: Prepared inputs compose in order.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__prepared_clocked_inv
idris.note: Prepared inputs keep the invariant.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__prepared_clocked_unfired
idris.note: Prepared inputs fire nothing.

idris.name: Ltim_2_8_4__step
idris.note: The clause's input with the sample the loop takes as it consumes it.

idris.name: iret_11_3__framed_fires_once_per_match_sampled
idris.note: Once per match through inputs each consumed at its own sample.

idris.name: iret_19_5__retime_clocked_clock
idris.note: The re-time after the clause's two steps moves no clock.

idris.name: iret_19_5__tick_clocked_clock
idris.note: After the clause's sample and sweep the clock is the sample.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_4__arrives_open
idris.note: A data event consumed at sample 1. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_4__arrives_open_chain
idris.note: The clause's sample and re-time before the event is applied, executed: the fact joins under the re-evaluated test. Computed.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_4__arrives_open_clock
idris.note: The clause's sample executed: the clock at 1. Computed.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_4__arrives_open_is_an_instance
idris.note: The theorem at the sampled data input: 1 for 1. Executed.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_4__expand
idris.note: This engine's order for one input: sample, sweep, re-time, cascade, then the event. The sample is the clause's ('whatever `clock_ns` the event carries'); the sweep is not where the clause puts it, which is the pump's entry, after the event is applied and before anything fires (RARC.7.15). Partial for that: under the clause the event joins an expired fact until the pump's sweep, here it never meets one.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_4__fact_then_tick_is_steps
idris.note: A tick input is a step with no event, and a sample at the clock already held changes nothing. Computed.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__advance_net_clock
idris.note: The clause's sample: the clock takes it, by `next_clock`.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__consume
idris.note: One input consumed at its sample, as the clause has it, and swept for as it is consumed, which the clause does not have: its sweep is the pump's. Partial for the placement.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__consume_is_prepared
idris.note: A data input samples the clock: the composed tick at the sample, then the event. Rete/NetworkClocked.idr's data input, which moved no clock, is replaced by this.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__consumed
idris.note: The steps for a list of inputs, no run between, each sampled as the clause has it and each swept for as it is consumed, which the clause's pump does instead. Partial for the placement.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__consumed_clock
idris.note: After consuming an input the clock is the sample taken for it, whatever the event carried.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__consumed_cons
idris.note: Steps consume one at a time.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__consumed_is_prepared
idris.note: Consuming steps is preparing their expansions.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__sweep_net_clock
idris.note: The clause's retraction of expired facts moves no clock.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_4__apply_ttl_net_clock
idris.note: The event applied after the sample moves no clock: 'whatever `clock_ns` the event carries'.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_3__tick_then_pump_is_clocked
idris.note: The sweep at the tick, then the re-time and the run: Rete/NetworkClocked.idr's pump at the tick, where the sweep is placed the same way.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_4__tick_timed
idris.note: The monotonic sample, taken; the sweep at the tick, as Rete/NetworkTtl.idr's prepare has it. LESS than the clause: the clause sweeps at the pump's entry, the model at the tick; the two coincide at every pump boundary the Idris model compares.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_4__tick_timed_projects
idris.note: The sweep is Rete/NetworkTtl.idr's, by projection.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__tick_literal_timed
idris.note: The consumption loop's clock input on a state with nothing to expire: the clock's move alone.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__timer_cycle
idris.note: The clock input taken in turn, then the pump; the sweep at the tick.

idris.name: ldet_5_8__quiet_tick_net
idris.note: A TICK THAT EXPIRES NOTHING MOVES ONLY THE CLOCK, on the network: working memory, terminals with their `fired` flags, dependency table and deadline table unchanged, so no activation is created, ended or re-armed by it. That is this clause's 'cycling the tick is not a change to the LHS' for the tests this engine has, which are predicates of facts: the clause's observable is a `now()` gate, which they do not read. On the one engine with both kinds of test, Rete/NetworkClocked.idr's `ldet_5_8__quiet_tick_clocked` is the statement, and Rete/NetworkTick.idr's `ldet_5_8__tick_keeps_activation` and `ldet_5_8__late_fires_once` carry the observable, on the flag reading.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__advance_net
idris.note: The advance, sharing Rete/TtlSweep.idr's choice of clock (`rarc_5_6_3__next_clock`).

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__prepare_net
idris.note: The loop's steps before firing on the network, in Rete/TtlSweep.idr's order: advance and sweep, or sweep and apply. Partial as `rarc_5_6_3__prepare` is: the clause sweeps at the pump's entry, not as an input is consumed. The agreement with FireLoop (`rlow_4_2_1__prepare_agree`) is between two models that place the sweep alike.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__sweep_net
idris.note: THE SWEEP ON THE NETWORK: every live fact whose deadline is at or before the clock retracted one at a time through alpha dispatch -- [IRET.19.3] step 2, `ds_rete_wm_retract` per fact -- in [LDTL.6.1]'s order, then the cascade.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__prepare_agree
idris.note: THE LOOP'S STEPS BEFORE FIRING AGREE: a tick advances both clocks alike and sweeps alike; a data event is swept for and applied alike.

idris.name: iret_19_5__tick_clocked_wall
idris.note: The clause's advance and sweep read no time-dependent test; the composed tick at two wall samples is one state.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__next_clock_lte
idris.note: The clock after the step is at or above the clock before it: the sample a conforming source gives never runs back ([LTIM.2.8.2]).

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__advance
idris.note: The clause's first half: the clock takes the tick's sample. A `Tick t` is the monotonic sample the source gave when the input was consumed, whatever `clock_ns` the event carried; `next_clock`'s guard against a value below the clock is one a conforming source never reaches ([LTIM.2.8.2]).

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__advance_lte
idris.note: The advance never turns the clock back.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__clock_monotone
idris.note: THE CLOCK NEVER RUNS BACKWARDS: across a boundary -- the input, the sweep, the pump -- it only advances.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__next_clock
idris.note: The clock the advance moves to: the tick's sample, guarded structurally against a sample below the clock, which [LTIM.2.8.2] rules out of any conforming source. Named so that Rete/NetworkTtl.idr's advance is the same function.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__prepare
idris.note: The loop's steps before firing, in this model's order: advance the clock if the input is a tick, sweep, apply the data event if any. The clause (RARC.7.15) samples at the input and sweeps at the PUMP'S ENTRY, an assert, a retract or a clock move retracting nothing. On a tick the two reach one state once the pump runs; on a data event the clause applies before it sweeps and this model sweeps before it applies, so a match the clause makes against an expired fact and ends at the pump never exists here. No theorem relates the two orders; the Idris model compares at pump boundaries alone, where they coincide. Partial for the placement.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__prepare_inv
idris.note: The steps before firing keep the invariant and never turn the clock back.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__sweep
idris.note: The clause's sweep: retract every `ttl` fact whose deadline is at or before the monotonic sample, propagate, cascade. What it does is the clause's; where it runs is `rarc_5_6_3__prepare`'s and that tie's `partial`.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__sweep_here_inv
idris.note: Sweeping at the current clock keeps the invariant.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__sweep_inv
idris.note: The sweep keeps the invariant, and re-establishes that every live deadline is in the future, whatever the clock was set to: this is what lets the clock advance.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__tick_inv
idris.note: Advancing then sweeping keeps the invariant: the advance touches only the clock, and the sweep restores the future-deadline part at the new clock.
